parameters.query: with input_json as (select $1::jsonb as p), input_data as (select p->>'workflow_run_id' as workflow_run_id, p->>'idempotency_key' as idempotency_key, p->>'status' as status, p->>'current_state' as current_state, p->>'repository_full_name' as repository_full_name, p->>'current_phase' as current_phase, p->>'target_branch_name' as target_branch_name, (p->>'max_retries')::integer as max_retries, p->>'event_type' as event_type, (p->>'event_payload_json')::jsonb as event_payload_json from input_json), upserted_run as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_runs (workflow_run_id, idempotency_key, status, current_state, repository_full_name, current_phase, target_branch_name, max_retries, created_at, updated_at) select workflow_run_id, idempotency_key, status, current_state, repository_full_name, current_phase, target_branch_name, max_retries, now(), now() from input_data on conflict (workflow_run_id) do update set idempotency_key = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.idempotency_key, status = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.status, current_state = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.current_state, repository_full_name = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.repository_full_name, current_phase = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.current_phase, target_branch_name = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.target_branch_name, max_retries = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.max_retries, updated_at = moex_n8n_workflow_runs.updated_at returning workflow_run_id, status, current_state, repository_full_name, current_phase, target_branch_name, retry_count, max_retries, created_at, updated_at, (xmax = 0) as inserted), inserted_event as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (workflow_run_id, previous_state, new_state, event_type, event_payload_json, created_at) select u.workflow_run_id, null, u.current_state, d.event_type, d.event_payload_json, now() from upserted_run u cross join input_data d where u.inserted = true returning event_id) select u.workflow_run_id, u.status, u.current_state, u.repository_full_name, u.current_phase, u.target_branch_name, u.retry_count, u.max_retries, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.inserted, e.event_id from upserted_run u left join inserted_event e on true;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { accepted: true, workflow_name: 'MOEX_ROUTE_B_INTAKE_ACK_V1_10_3', spec_version: '1.10.3', workflow_run_id: $json.workflow_run_id, status: $json.status, current_state: $json.current_state, repository_full_name: $json.repository_full_name, target_branch_name: $json.target_branch_name, idempotent_replay: !$json.inserted } }}
